title: Prophecy against Tyre and Sidon
description: A prophecy concerning the fall of Tyre and Sidon: The ships of Tarshish lament because the port city is destroyed, and the merchants of Sidon must remain silent. The Lord of hosts has planned judgment to humble all pride and the noblest on earth. Tyre shall be forgotten for seventy years, like the lifespan of a king, and then return to her trade. Finally, her earnings will be dedicated to the Lord and given to those who dwell before the face of the Lord.
